summary: QA: pagination loses the active filter after reload, and page 2 returns rows of another user when the filter is applied.

findings.problem: GET /api/history?type=transfer&page=2 as user-a returned 3 rows with owner_id=user-b (evidence ev-e2e-0151, ev-db-0152); the filtered query path drops the owner condition.
findings.expected_fix: Apply the server-verified owner filter on every query path, including the filtered one, and add the isolation scenario SC-1-2 for filtered pages.

findings.problem: After reload on page 2 with type=transfer the list shows page 1 unfiltered; URL query parameters are not read on mount (evidence ev-e2e-0153).
findings.expected_fix: Initialize filter and page state from the URL so that reload preserves both.

checked_criteria: AC-2 filter and pagination after reload

criteria.action: GET /api/history?type=transfer&page=2 as user-a; compare owner_id with DB
Filter type=transfer, open page 2, reload browser
criteria.observed: After reload page 1 without filter is shown
